name: Tammy Linnet
source:
Part of the trio, Tammy takes her materialism to its limit. Obsessed with having the best—fashion, decor, and food—Tammy is a bougie girl who will only involve herself with true ballers. Although, she'll make an exception for a partner with the right-sized "equipment".

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
